title: Design System: Tatsuro — The Noon Postcard

ocean-deep.displayName: Ocean Deep 深水青(承载文字/状态)

turquoise-deep.displayName: Turquoise Deep 深水绿松(深水渐变端点)

coral-ink.displayName: Coral Ink 焦糖珊瑚(浅底上的珊瑚文字/图标)

sky-bright.displayName: Sky Bright 亮天青(黄昏主题 primary)

cobalt-deep.displayName: Cobalt Deep 深钴蓝(深锚点)

deep-navy.displayName: Deep Navy 深海军蓝(文字)

ink-mist.displayName: Ink Mist 雾蓝(muted 文字下限)

dusk-navy.displayName: Dusk Navy 暮夜蓝(黄昏背景)

dusk-deep.displayName: Dusk Deep 暮海蓝(黄昏卡片/播放条底)

dusk-plum.displayName: Dusk Plum 暮色紫红(黄昏天际线)

display.purpose: 页面主标题、Gate 页艺术家名。600 字重仅此处与按钮允许。

headline.purpose: 专辑名、全屏播放器歌名。

japanese.purpose: 日文歌名/标题专用圆体;歌词等日文长文改用 --font-jp-gothic 标准黑体(2026-07 拍板)。

shadows.name: lift-navy
shadows.purpose: 白卡片在浅背景上的默认抬升;安静、几乎不可见。

shadows.name: lift-ocean
shadows.purpose: 青色系按钮/激活元素的悬停光晕。

shadows.name: postcard
shadows.purpose: 专辑封面明信片卡的常驻纸感投影。

motion.name: ease-lazy
motion.purpose: 默认交互缓动(ease-out-quint 系),慵懒丝滑。

motion.name: duration-ambient
motion.purpose: 氛围动效(阳光呼吸、水面光斑)周期;幅度极小,reduced-motion 时静止。

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 主操作按钮:深水渐变(#0C8097→#0A8473)胶囊,白字 4.6:1,悬停上浮 + 青色光晕。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0C8097, #0A8473); color: #fff; font-family: Quicksand, ui-rounded, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -8px rgba(28,167,196,0.7); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0C8097; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: CTA / Like Button
components.description: CTA / 收藏:Coral Ink 实色胶囊,白字 5.3:1;落日的暖意由悬停珊瑚光晕承担。
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { background: #B04E23; color: #fff; font-family: Quicksand, ui-rounded, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -8px rgba(255,138,91,0.7); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B04E23; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: 次级操作:白底 + Sky 细边 + 深海军蓝文字。
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #0B3A53; font-family: Quicksand, ui-rounded, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #BFE9F2; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #0C8097; box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -16px rgba(11,58,83,0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0C8097; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: 筛选标签(All · Studio · Live):Sky 浅底;选中转深水渐变白字。
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #BFE9F2; color: #0B3A53; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: #A9DEEC; } .ds-chip-selected { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0C8097, #0A8473); color: #fff; }

components.name: Album Postcard Card
components.description: 专辑明信片卡:白底、20px 圆角、纸感投影,悬停像拿起一张明信片。
components.html:
For You
1982 · Studio
components.css: .ds-card { width: 180px; background: #fff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 12px 22px -14px rgba(11,58,83,0.35); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 28px -14px rgba(11,58,83,0.45); } .ds-card-cover { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #7FD0EC 0%, #A7E0EF 18%, #DFF4F1 46%, #FFF8EE 100%); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Quicksand, ui-rounded, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #0B3A53; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #4C7083; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: 搜索框:白底胶囊、Sky 描边、focus 转海洋青 ring。
components.css: .ds-input-search { background: #fff; color: #0B3A53; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #BFE9F2; border-radius: 999px; width: 220px; transition: border-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #4C7083; } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0C8097; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(12,128,151,0.35); }

components.name: Progress Scrubber
components.description: 签名组件:Sky 轨道 + 深水渐变已播段(3.7:1 状态对比)+ 白色拖点带青色光晕。
components.css: .ds-scrubber { width: 260px; } .ds-scrubber-track { height: 4px; background: #BFE9F2; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-scrubber-fill { position: relative; width: 38%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0C8097, #0A8473); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-scrubber-thumb { position: absolute; right: -6px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 12px; height: 12px; background: #fff; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(28,167,196,0.7); } .ds-scrubber-time { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #4C7083; }

components.name: Glass Button (over photo)
components.description: 暗照片 chrome:白磨砂玻璃 + 白发光描边 + 白字(配浅 navy scrim 使用);选中态 glass-active = 实白底 + navy 字。
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(11,58,83,0.55); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); border-radius: 999px; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-glass-active { background: #fff; color: #0B3A53; text-shadow: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px -6px rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }

components.name: Glass Ink Button (over bright wash)
components.description: 亮洗 chrome(专辑页封面环境光):亮玻璃 + 墨字——白字 glass 的姊妹形态。返回 pill、未选中 Edition chip 用它。
components.css: .ds-btn-glass-ink { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); color: #0B3A53; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.7); border-radius: 999px; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-glass-ink:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); } .ds-btn-glass-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0C8097; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Frosted Sheet (GlassPanel)
components.description: 照片/环境层上的标准内容 sheet(components/glass-panel.tsx):微模糊白玻璃,黄昏换 dusk-navy/60;圆角/阴影留在调用处。首页网格与专辑曲目列表共用。
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.55); border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 22px -14px rgba(11,58,83,0.35); width: 260px; } .ds-glass-panel-line { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #0B3A53; padding: 8px 4px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: 顶部轻导航:Quicksand 字标 + 平铺链接;激活项 Ocean Deep 文字 + 下方浅水渐变短线(装饰)。

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; font-family: Quicksand, ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #0B3A53; margin-right: 12px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #4C7083; text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 2px; transition: color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0B3A53; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0C8097; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-nav-active { color: #0C8097; } .ds-nav-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1CA7C4, #2FBFA8); }

narrative.overview: 场景句(拍板原话):青蓝色的透明海,白色的沙滩,棕榈树,阳光。整个系统是一张正午海边寄出的明信片:高明度、低饱和、大面积留白、平涂色块和干净的边缘。通透感是第一目标,来自画面整体亮、颜色不铺满每一像素、平涂加利落边缘的叠加。视觉母题是永井博与铃木英人的 City Pop 封面美学。真实摄影是一等材质:界面质感靠真实海景照片承载,照片只要海、天、白沙、棕榈,平视视角;照片之上的 UI 层遵守磨砂玻璃纪律。明确拒绝深紫/品红霓虹夜店风、重阴影、玻璃叠玻璃、手绘装饰与营销腔文案。
keyCharacteristics: 高明度 + 低饱和 + 大留白 = 通透(不可妥协的第一原则)
平涂色块、干净边缘;渐变只用于环境层与品牌渐变(浅水装饰,深水按钮)
真实海景照片做质感底,浅色 overlay,磨砂玻璃托底内容
深钴蓝/深海军蓝做深锚点,亮的更亮、深的更深
动效像海边的光:8–20 秒极慢周期、几乎察觉不到
双主题:正午(默认浅色)与黄昏(暗色,暮蓝非黑夜)

rules.name: The Transparency Rule(通透律)
rules.body: 任何新增颜色/图层先问:它降低画面明度了吗?让边界发脏了吗?是,就重做。深色蒙版能不压就不压,要压也压到 14–28% 透明度的浅 navy 为止。

rules.name: The Deep Anchor Rule(深锚律)
rules.body: 每一屏至少有一处 Deep Navy 或 Cobalt 的深色锚点。没有深锚点的画面会发平、发灰。

rules.name: The One Sunset Rule(一抹落日律)
rules.body: Coral 及其暖色家族在任一屏面积 ≤10%:它是落日,不是墙漆。

rules.name: The Deep Water Rule(深水律)
rules.body: 浅水做氛围,深水载信息。Ocean/Turquoise/Coral 原色只做不承载信息的装饰;文字、图标、状态所在的彩色表面一律用深水形态(Ocean Deep #0C8097 / Turquoise Deep #0A8473 / Coral Ink #B04E23,全部 ≥4.5:1)。浅水对白字实测仅 2.3–2.9:1,任何字号都不达标。

rules.name: The Light-Weight Rule(轻字重律)
rules.body: 层级靠大小和间距拉开,不靠加黑。400–500 是常态,600 只给 Display 和按钮,700 禁用。

rules.name: The Mixed-Script Rule(混排律)
rules.body: UI chrome 一律英文;歌名/专辑名等日文标题用 Zen Maru Gothic,歌词等日文长文用 --font-jp-gothic 标准黑体(Hiragino Sans/Yu Gothic/Noto Sans JP 系统栈,font-jp-gothic 工具类覆盖 :lang(ja));行高 1.7,禁止拉丁字体伪回退。

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule(暖影律)
rules.body: 阴影必须带色(元素本色或暖色)、单方向向下、负 spread 收紧。看到 rgba(0,0,0,…) 的大糊影就是违规。

rules.name: The Glass Discipline Rule(玻璃纪律)
rules.body: 照片/环境层上的内容层用磨砂玻璃托底;平涂背景上用不透明实色;迷你播放条永远实色;玻璃叠玻璃绝对禁止。标准 sheet 配方 = GlassPanel 组件:正午 rgba(255,255,255,0.45)+border-white/55,黄昏 dusk-navy/60+border-white/15,统一微模糊 backdrop-blur-xs(~4px)。

rules.name: The Light Overlay Rule(浅罩律)
rules.body: 照片上压字用浅 navy 渐变 scrim(14–28%),绝不用深黑蒙版把照片压死。

dos: Do 保持每屏的深色锚点:Deep Navy 文字或 Cobalt 元素至少一处。
Do 用真实精致的海景照片提升质感——只要海、天、白沙、棕榈树,平视视角。
Do 让动效像海边的光:8–20 秒周期缓慢呼吸,交互 400–600ms ease-out,全部配 prefers-reduced-motion 替代。
Do 文案朴素、功能性;UI 一律英文,日文内容用 Zen Maru Gothic。
Do 分层优先用细线或换平涂色;必须投影时带色、浅、单方向向下。
donts: Don't 使用深紫/品红霓虹夜店风及任何霓虹脉冲、一惊一乍的动画。
Don't 写做作、煽情、营销腔文案。
Don't 用手绘装饰元素;质感只来自真实照片与干净平涂。
Don't 玻璃叠玻璃;迷你播放条永远实色。
Don't 用重黑阴影、多方向糊影或深色蒙版压照片。
Don't 用纯黑文字(用 Deep Navy),muted 文字不淡过 Ink Mist(4.5:1 红线)。
Don't 把文字或必需图标放在浅水原色(Ocean/Turquoise/Coral/Sun)上;要么换深水形态,要么保持纯装饰(深水律)。
Don't 满屏加粗、渐变文字、侧色条、同尺寸卡片无限网格等 AI 模板痕迹。
